releaseNotes: Fixes a crash at launch on macOS 15 and macOS 26 when a project, idea, submission, grant or deadline had been left half filled in, or still linked to a deleted publication. When it opens your library, Vitae now fills any missing required field with its usual starting value and clears links to deleted records. A status or type from a newer version of Vitae shows as the first option instead of stopping the app. No record is removed.
